summary: External storage transfer stats incorrectly sum durations of concurrent driver invocations instead of measuring actual wall-clock time. For example, 3 concurrent drivers each taking 100ms are reported as 300ms instead of ~100ms.
userImpact: Users receive inaccurate transfer statistics that overestimate the actual time spent on external storage operations.
rootCause: The code sums durations of individual driver invocations instead of tracking the wall-clock duration of overlapping concurrent operations.
proposedFix: Use edge detection to track and record durations.
keyQuote: External storage transfer stats are summing the durations of each driver invocation instead of tracking overlapping intervals.
